headline: Not good for texture and acne

I have oily to combo acne prone textured skin, and while this looks beautiful on smooth skin that isn't too textured just a normal amount, it looked heavy and unflattering on any acne bumps or textures skin. I don't have just small pimples I deal with very large cystic acne that is sensitive to touch when it's healing and most products don't sit well on it, but a few products do mainly liquid or cream. I can see this working on combo skin that doesn't have a huge texture problem and only has a few small pimples that aren't cystic. This sat horribly on my forehead where I struggle with texture issues. Even after moisturizing well and prepping my skin it didn't look great.
You have to really buff this into the skin to get the most out of it, and with my acne being on a good part of my face it was uncomfortable for me. It would be worth it if didn't end up looking heavy and cakey. 

If you have smoothish skin and like a satin finish I think you'd enjoy this! If you struggle with texture and makeup not sitting well on your skin this won't be a miracle worker. I'd rather spend the money on something that will work for my skin type.

headline: Your Skin But Better
comments:

In the Clinique Beyond Perfecting I'm in CN52 and it is quite possibly the best match I've ever found in a cream / liquid foundation. 
B/c I love the ease, simplicity, and quickness of my powder foundations, I don't typically reach for a liquid or cream foundation - especially in the summer! But, I chose this as my "Diamond" reward â¦ and I am so pleasantly surprised!
I didn't care for the doe foot applicator at first â¦ however, it is NOT messy and I never have to get my fingers, or the back of my hand messy or goopy â¦ so I've decided it's a perfect idea! I dot it on, one area at a time, and use a brush for blending and application. It dries down very quickly, so I literally apply one area at a time. It's easy to build if needed.

headline: For the price it's impressive
comments:
I've been a Bare Minerals Matte user for years, but the cost of a container has gone up to $40 and I found it necessary to retrench. I gave this makeup a shot. It's not as natural or smooth as Bare Minerals, and despite the greater options for color matching this Neutral tone 112 is much more bright yellow than my skin -- but it covers very well, I was quite impressed with that. It reminds me of a power foundation I bought circa 2001 from Hourglass (which cost $40 BACK THEN) so it's in the realm of the good quality stuff. It's just cakey, and it goes on unevenly with a tendency to clump up. I tried using the included applicator and it became all thick and gummed up before I finished applying a full face of makeup -- I use instead a dense, short-bristled brush for application, and tap it on, which gets better results over the pores. If you need to retouch a patch later on it's hopeless, you can't get the makeup even again (this is a common issue with powder foundation, even Bare Minerals.) 
All in all I'm unsure if I'd buy this again. It's less expensive than Bare Minerals but so are many things. If I get it again, I might try a Cool shade (even though I'm a Neutral) to see if it yields a closer hue, since the yellowish tone makes a  plain demarcation against my neck color (the cosmetic really needs more of a dull brown to balance it out.)

headline: Not a foundation lover but I LOVE this!
comments: I don't know why this isn't sold in stores! It's absolutely fantastic! I don't normally like wearing liquid foundation because it feels heavy but this one is so light and actually does provide good coverage without the heaviness. I have plenty of acne scars and discoloration and it makes my skin appear almost flawless - basically solid coverage without feeling like full coverage heavy foundation. I don't even need to wear concealer under my eyes or elsewhere when I use this. I like to apply it by squeezing a few lines onto each area of my face directly from the tube and then work it in with a brush. I go back in with a dab of liquid bronzer to give my face dimension. If I have time I'll let it dry 5-10 min and set very lightly by pushing in some setting powder. It ends up with a nice dewy finish but if you go heavier on the setting powder you can get closer to matte if that's what you like. Lastly, I wear the ivory shade which works in combination with the bronzer but would otherwise be too pale (I'm a 2N1 in Estee Lauder powder in winter and 2N2 in summer). I just ordered the golden ivory in this product for summer but again, with bronzer the ivory still works for me all year.

headline: This really is a hero! I don't ever want to be without it!
comments: I ignored this product ever since it came out and didn't think it was something I really needed. Then I got a sample and WHOA! I don't ever want to be without it. This stuff is the real deal!  At first I became interested because it just felt so good on my face, so I ordered a small tube and used it for several days. A few weeks before I got the sample, I had gotten a pimple for the first time in literally YEARS (I'm in my 50s) and it was one of those that wound up scarring somewhat, and it was one of those spots that looked like it might not go away and was in a VERY visible place on my lower cheek near my mouth. I really wasn't much into skin care until the last few years when I started trying to take better care of my skin, so I was really upset about this new spot.  After a week or so, it seemed to have faded. After a few weeks now? That spot is barely there at all! I am 110% a believer in Skin Hero now! It just feels really nice, no scent to me, and the skin on my face just feels softer, better, and definitely looks better. It just feels like it's really doing something and working!  I'm using CC Red Correct (which I also ignored for a while ; thought I didn't need since I don't have rosacea or a lot of redness) after Skin Hero - turns out after 2 years of using CC Cream in Clair, the CC Red Correct shade is MUCH better suited to my extremely fair skin ; blonde hair - now, between Skin Hero helping fade the new spot that was bothering me and it + CC Red Correct basically covering up all of my imperfections (some veins around my nose and a few other red spots here and there) - my face has never looked better! I prefer to go without makeup most days ; don't really need it but occasionally, and now with CC Red Correct + Skin Hero, I am fine with skipping makeup most of the time. They are both just THAT good!  Skin Hero + CC Red Correct are also even helping with my hereditary dark circles under my eyes, which there's realistically no real cure for. Are they still there? Yes. Do they look better? DEFINITELY!  I have used the BB ; CC Creams in Clair for over 2 years now and have stopped using foundation entirely, but I really wish I'd discovered the CC Red Correct first before the CC Cream in Clair! And now with Skin Hero + CC Red Correct, I expect I will still layer BB Cream in Clair on top on the rare times when I'm going out and want to have a little more coverage, but Skin Hero + CC Red Correct are now my go-to every single day team, and I don't ever want to have to go without either of them.   If you have been on the fence about trying Skin Hero - and I get it, I honestly didn't think I needed it or would be interested, pretty much ever since Erborian came out with it - I urge you to get a sample or small tube of Skin Hero and try it and see! I seriously do not ever want to be without it ever again now!

headline: Your Skin But Better
comments:
For reference, I'm in my 60's with normal skin, not oily, a teensy dry on my cheeks, forehead, and under my eyes, a few wrinkles, etc. In It Cosmetics I'm medium to medium tan. In the Clinique Beyond Perfecting I'm in CN52 and it is quite possibly the best match I've ever found in a cream / liquid foundation. 
B/c I love the ease, simplicity, and quickness of my powder foundations, I don't typically reach for a liquid or cream foundation - especially in the summer! But, I chose this as my "Diamond" reward â¦ and I am so pleasantly surprised!
I didn't care for the doe foot applicator at first â¦ however, it is NOT messy and I never have to get my fingers, or the back of my hand messy or goopy â¦ so I've decided it's a perfect idea! I dot it on, one area at a time, and use a brush for blending and application. It dries down very quickly, so I literally apply one area at a time. It's easy to build if needed. 
This truly could be the original "Your Skin But Better" look. I find it to be excellent coverage, blendable, and reliably and nicely long wearing â¦ even in our extraordinarily higher and more humid than normal, HOT, desert summer Vegas days. I dont find it to be cakey looking or settle into fine lines â¦ its just "Beyond Perfect" â¦ actually! 
I dont find this to be "dewy" looking but neither does it appear - or feel "drying." I dont have issues w/oily breakthru so I really can't speak to that. 
Lastly, if you're close to an Ulta, I would suggest trying it "in store" for your perfect shade. Just "picking" online, I got one too light the first time. And remember, Ulta has a flawless Satisfaction Guarantee so you cant lose giving it a try!

comments: I have been using the tinted moisturizer for years. I was extremely disappointed that the old formula was discontinued medium to dark tint is my absolute perfect shade. headline: Nasty replacement for beloved tinted moisturizer
comments: Do not be fooled by the sales staff!  I used BB Oil Free Tinted Moisturizer in Extra Light tint for decades.  The new owners discontinued it and they expect you to love this. First, if you have the slightest bit of oil in your skin, expect to be shiny within minutes of wearing this.  Also, the colors are now terrible.  I have fair skin with cool undertonesâthat doesn't exist anymore in the right shade of fair.  It's also thickâthe consistency is more mashed avocado than creamy light mayo. Very difficult to spread evenly with your fingers (as suggested) because it locks in where you first begin so you use more to get even coverage and then it looks caked on. Gone are the days of the barely there, light coverage that simply evens your skin tone. I used to get so many compliments on my skin, not anymore with this nasty junk. And don't get me started on the perfume smell. Puke. Super disappointing.  Buyer beware.

headline: Love it, perfect "no makeup" glow
comments: I love this for a "no makeup" glow. I waited 20 min after my skin care and applied using my fingers. I was so happy it went on flawlessly and blended so nicely. Truly looks like my skin but better. It feels hydrating and lightweight, and lasted all day without creasing. Love it!

headline: No light coverage/No evening out skin tone
comments: This is not a substitute for "Nude Finish Tinted Moisturizer SPF15" .  As a replacement for that perfect light covering that evened out my skin tone , this "Vitamin Enriched Skin Tint Broad Spectrum SPF15" is a great disappointment.  It doesn't cover anything on my face.  It doesn't even out anything on my face.  And... I have never written a review before!  Greatly disappointed.
